_note: Every course, in display order. A course is an ordered list of lessons (public/content/lessons/<slug>.json). layer: foundation (built once, used in every programme), bridge (one arm's world; arm is set), tool (1 standalone lesson). loop: which move of the loop the course belongs to (centre, clarify, choose, return) or null. Drafts are hidden. Ids never change once a programme lists them. Format: docs/content-format.md.
